question: 某线路的等值电路如图所示，已知末端功率S₂=11.77+j5.45 MVA、末端电压U₂=110∠0° kV，则始端功率S₁和始端电压U₁为下列哪组数值？
explanation:
# 输电线路等值电路计算

## 已知条件

- 末端功率：$S_2 = 11.77 + j5.45 \text{ MVA}$
- 末端电压：$U_2 = 110\angle 0° \text{ kV}$
- 线路阻抗：$Z = 13.2 + j16.68 \text{ Ω}$
- 两端并联导纳：$jB/2 = j0.555 \times 10^{-4} \text{ S}$（各一个）

## 求解过程

**第一步：末端充电功率**

$$Q_{C2} = U_2^2 \cdot \frac{B}{2} = (110)^2 \times 0.555 \times 10^{-4} = 0.671 \text{ Mvar}$$

**第二步：流入阻抗的功率**

$$S_Z = P_2 + j(Q_2 - Q_{C2}) = 11.77 + j(5.45 - 0.671) = 11.77 + j4.779 \text{ MVA}$$

**第三步：线路电流**

$$|\dot{I}| = \frac{\sqrt{11.77^2 + 4.779^2}}{\sqrt{3} \times 110} \times 10^3 \approx 66.7 \text{ A}$$

**第四步：阻抗功率损耗**

$$\Delta P = \frac{11.77^2 + 4.779^2}{110^2} \times 13.2 \approx 0.176 \text{ MW}$$

$$\Delta Q = \frac{11.77^2 + 4.779^2}{110^2} \times 16.68 \approx 0.223 \text{ Mvar}$$

**第五步：始端功率**

$$S_1 = (11.77 + 0.176) + j(4.779 + 0.223 - 0.671) \approx 11.95 + j4.30 \text{ MVA}$$

**第六步：始端电压**

$$\Delta U \approx \frac{P_Z R + Q_Z X}{U_2} \approx 2.14 \text{ kV},\quad \delta U \approx \frac{P_Z X - Q_Z R}{U_2} \approx 1.21 \text{ kV}$$

$$\dot{U}_1 \approx 112.14\angle 0.62° \text{ kV}$$

## 答案

$U_1 = 112.14\angle 0.62° \text{ kV},\ S_1 = 11.95 + j4.30 \text{ MVA}$，**选 (B)**
